summary: Updates quantity on a Direct Issue line item location, or voids the location.
description:
Updates the quantity on a specific inventory location associated with a Direct Issue line item.
On a Requirement-linked Draft line, increasing the issue quantity above quantity assigned returns 422, and increasing it above quantity remaining to be issued returns 422. Both can be returned together. A change that lowers the quantity is accepted even when the total is still above either cap.
In Draft, a quantity of 0 deletes the location row. On a Final Direct Issue, set void to true
(admin only, behind materials_management_void-enabled) to void that location: the source row
is kept at quantity 0 and the matching hidden-transfer line is zeroed. After a successful void,
`previous_quantity` on that location is the quantity from before it was zeroed.
Optional `notes` may be sent with void; they overwrite the parent line's notes (line-level,
not location-level). Voiding the last remaining active location sets the document header status to VOID.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
